headline: Structures from a table, ALT takes, and a readable plan
highlights: A structure can be imported from a table — file names plus folder layers, as deep as you need — and reopened to review or edit its rows
ALT takes recognized by your own suffixes and filed into an _ALT subfolder or beside their main take
Both Organise sheets open on a labeled tally of what the run will do, and the app opens on a proper mode menu
